head.b:skin:
/* Open Debug Theme variables. Descriptions intentionally use plain text accepted by Blogger skin parsing. */ <Group description="Theme Colors"> <Variable name="key.color" description="Primary color" type="color" default="#2563eb" value="#2563eb"/> <Variable name="body.background" description="Page background" type="color" default="#f8fafc" value="#f8fafc"/> <Variable name="card.background" description="Card background" type="color" default="#ffffff" value="#ffffff"/> <Variable name="text.color" description="Text color" type="color" default="#0f172a" value="#0f172a"/> <Variable name="muted.color" description="Muted text color" type="color" default="#64748b" value="#64748b"/> </Group> <Group description="Theme Layout"> <Variable name="content.width" description="Content width" type="length" min="720px" max="1440px" default="1180px" value="1180px"/> <Variable name="sidebar.width" description="Sidebar width" type="length" min="240px" max="380px" default="320px" value="320px"/> <Variable name="card.radius" description="Card radius" type="length" min="0px" max="32px" default="18px" value="18px"/> </Group> <Group description="Optional Features"> <Variable name="feature.cookie" description="Cookie notice 1 off 2 on" type="length" min="1px" max="2px" default="2px" value="2px"/> <Variable name="feature.dark" description="Dark toggle 1 off 2 on" type="length" min="1px" max="2px" default="2px" value="2px"/> <Variable name="feature.safelink" description="Link gate 1 off 2 on" type="length" min="1px" max="2px" default="1px" value="1px"/> <Variable name="feature.ads" description="Ad placeholders 1 off 2 on" type="length" min="1px" max="2px" default="1px" value="1px"/> </Group>
:root{--key:$(key.color);--bg:$(body.background);--card:$(card.background);--text:$(text.color);--muted:$(muted.color);--max:$(content.width);--side:$(sidebar.width);--radius:$(card.radius);color-scheme:light} [data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0f172a;--card:#111827;--text:#e5e7eb;--muted:#94a3b8;--key:#60a5fa;color-scheme:dark} *{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:16px/1.65 system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}a{color:var(--key);text-decoration:none}a:hover{text-decoration:underline}img,iframe{max-width:100%;height:auto}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}.skip-link{left:-999px;position:absolute;top:auto}.skip-link:focus{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--key);border-radius:10px;left:1rem;padding:.7rem 1rem;top:1rem;z-index:20}.site-header{backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(14px);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--card) 88%,transparent);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10}.header-inner{align-items:center;display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:space-between;margin:auto;max-width:var(--max);padding:.9rem 1rem}.brand{color:var(--text);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:800}.nav{align-items:center;display:flex;gap:.75rem}.nav a,.icon-button{border-radius:999px;color:var(--text);padding:.55rem .8rem}.nav a:hover,.icon-button:hover{background:rgba(148,163,184,.16);text-decoration:none}.icon-button{background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer}.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--key) 20%,transparent),transparent);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.2)}.hero-inner{margin:auto;max-width:var(--max);padding:3rem 1rem}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,4rem);line-height:1.05;margin:0 0 1rem}.hero p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1rem;margin:0;max-width:760px}.layout{display:grid;gap:1.5rem;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) var(--side);margin:auto;max-width:var(--max);padding:1.5rem 1rem}.main,.sidebar .widget,.post-card,.blog-pager,.empty-state,.ad-slot{background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.06)}.main{overflow:hidden}.blog-posts{display:grid;gap:1rem;padding:1rem}.post-card{padding:1.25rem}.post-title{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .5rem}.post-title a{color:var(--text)}.post-meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:1rem}.post-body{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.post-body pre{background:#0b1020;border-radius:14px;color:#e5e7eb;overflow:auto;padding:1rem}.read-more{align-items:center;background:var(--key);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;display:inline-flex;font-weight:700;margin-top:1rem;padding:.65rem 1rem}.read-more:hover{text-decoration:none}.sidebar{display:grid;gap:1rem;align-content:start}.sidebar .widget{padding:1rem}.widget h2,.widget-title{font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 .8rem}.Label ul,.PageList ul,.LinkList ul,.PopularPosts ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.Label li,.PageList li,.LinkList li,.PopularPosts li{border-top:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.2);padding:.55rem 0}.blog-pager{align-items:center;display:flex;gap:.75rem;justify-content:space-between;margin:1rem;padding:1rem}.blog-pager a{font-weight:700}.comments{border-top:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1rem}.ad-slot{color:var(--muted);display:grid;min-height:92px;place-items:center;text-align:center}.site-footer{border-top:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);color:var(--muted);margin-top:2rem}.footer-inner{margin:auto;max-width:var(--max);padding:2rem 1rem}.cookie{align-items:center;background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.35);border-radius:18px;bottom:1rem;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.18);display:none;gap:1rem;left:1rem;max-width:520px;padding:1rem;position:fixed;z-index:30}.cookie.show{display:flex}.cookie button,.gate button{background:var(--key);border:0;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;padding:.6rem 1rem}.gate{background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);border-radius:16px;margin:1rem 0;padding:1rem;text-align:center}.gate a{display:inline-flex;margin-top:.75rem}.search-panel{background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);display:none;inset:0;position:fixed;z-index:25}.search-panel.open{display:block}.search-box{background:var(--card);border-radius:22px;margin:10vh auto 0;max-width:680px;padding:1rem}.search-box form{display:flex;gap:.5rem}.search-box input{border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.45);border-radius:999px;flex:1;padding:.75rem 1rem}.search-box button{border:0;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;padding:.75rem 1rem}@media (max-width:900px){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nav{display:none}.mobile-nav-open .nav{background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);display:grid;left:0;padding:1rem;position:absolute;right:0;top:100%}.header-inner{position:relative}}@media (min-width:901px){.menu-toggle{display:none}}@media print{.site-header,.sidebar,.cookie,.site-footer,.blog-pager{display:none}.layout{display:block}.main{box-shadow:none}}

p.b:if: A clean Blogger theme for private debugging, import testing, responsive publishing, SEO metadata, dark mode, cookie notice, ads placeholders, and simple link gating.

b:if.div: Ad placeholder configure your own ad code in Layout

div.p: Create posts in Blogger to populate this theme. No demo content is bundled.

b:if.div: Optional link gate is enabled for manual links with class gated-link.

div.p: Open Debug Theme. No restricted assets or demo content bundled.

div.span: This site uses cookies for Blogger features and analytics you configure.
